entries.title: 露珠药圃
entries.eventDescription: 朝露还挂在矮篱上。{actor}认出一片被旅人照料过的银叶草，旁边的陶杯里留着干净的井水。队伍只取了足够的几片叶子，把踩倒的篱笆扶正。
entries.scene: A small forgotten medicinal herb garden at dawn beside a forest path, silver-green leaves holding oversized luminous dew drops, an earthenware cup of clean water on a low stone wall, a humble bent wicker fence being set upright by a cloaked traveler. Gentle hopeful discovery, close foreground plants with the traveling party small in the background, warm sunrise and cool mint greens. No lettering or visible text.

entries.title: 啄木鸟的空仓
entries.eventDescription: 一只啄木鸟对着木棚敲得震天响。{actor}拨开藤蔓，发现鸟儿只是想搬开堵在巢口的旧木条。棚里早已没有粮食，却有一捆尚未腐烂的木料。
entries.scene: A vivid red-headed woodpecker clinging to the roof beam of a tiny abandoned woodland storehouse, ivy covering its tilted roof, a traveler carefully loosening a plank that blocks the bird nest, a bundle of usable sawn timber revealed inside. Playful forest discovery, amber dappled sunlight, moss and worn wood, distinct close-up woodpecker silhouette. No text.

entries.title: 渡鸦的找零
entries.eventDescription: 渡鸦叼走了{actor}鞋带上的铜扣，又嫌它不够闪亮。它把铜扣扔回脚边时，巢里一枚不知藏了多久的金币也跟着滚了下来。
entries.scene: A mischievous raven perched on a weathered milepost, holding a small copper boot buckle in its beak while a single bright gold coin tumbles toward a bewildered traveler's boot. Comical intimate roadside scene, open countryside behind, strong raven silhouette and shining falling coin, late-afternoon light. No signage letters or text.

entries.title: 雾中的旧界碑
entries.eventDescription: 雾把前路抹成一片灰白。{actor}在旧界碑背面摸到几道凿痕：每一道都正对一处避风口。那不是王国的边界，而是过去赶山人互相留下的生路。
entries.scene: An ancient boundary stone emerging from dense pale mountain fog, a gloved traveler tracing simple chiseled directional grooves on the reverse side, layered sheltering rock notches faintly visible beyond. Quiet archaeological discovery, cold slate blue mist and a small warm lantern, mysterious but peaceful. Abstract worn marks only, no readable writing.

entries.title: 热石上的薄饼
entries.eventDescription: 路边的牧羊人正在热石上烙薄饼。听说小队还要赶很远的路，她多翻了几张，把最焦脆的边角留给自己；羊群则认真盯着所有人的手。
entries.scene: A cheerful elderly shepherd woman baking rustic flatbread on a broad hot stone over a low roadside fire, passing steaming bread to tired travelers, curious woolly sheep staring at their hands. Warm pastoral midday scene, golden crust, ochre grass and soft cream wool, hospitable atmosphere. No text.
entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the supplied event illustration in the clean flat-color fantasy comic style of the second image.
Image 1 = content/composition target, event 205 "Flatbread on a Hot Stone". Image 2 = ONLY the approved linework, color and shading reference. Do not reproduce Image 1's realistic painterly texture or Image 2's individual adventurer/costume/tavern.
Preserve Image 1's landscape 3:2 aspect ratio and story: a warm, smiling elderly shepherd woman with gray hair under an ivory kerchief offers a fresh flatbread to a tired adult traveler; two companions and curious sheep watch; several flatbreads bake on a broad heated stone over a low fire in the foreground beside a rural road. Preserve the important hand-to-bread interaction, sheep silhouettes and hospitable mood. Simplify the distant landscape and settlement into low-detail shapes so the main interaction dominates.
Fully REDRAW as hand-inked 2D fantasy comic art: fine dark organic outlines, a few purposeful inner lines for folds and hair, expressive simplified faces, believable stylized adult anatomy, broad uninterrupted matte flat colors. Match the approved reference's clean surface finish. Each material gets one clear base color and a small number of crisp cel-shadow shapes. Use no all-over texture. Wool is a clean ivory silhouette with a few curving strokes, skin smooth flat warm peach/copper, cloth smooth teal/brick-red/cream shapes, leather clean russet brown. Keep the older woman's age through facial shape and a few expression lines rather than many wrinkles.
Fresh clear daylight colors: teal and cool green clothing/foliage contrasted with warm brick-red garments and golden flatbread, muted blue mountain silhouettes. Preserve each actor's distinct costume; do not turn everyone into the reference adventurer. Sparse short cream steam shapes, simple orange fire shapes, no glow. Reduce background detail and draw rocks, leaves and wood as large clean shapes.
Full bleed to all edges. No text, UI, border, title, speech bubbles, signatures or watermark. Avoid painterly blending, mottled grunge, paper/parchment grain, speckled rocks, realistic texture, dense hatchwork, heavy outlines, muddy brown wash, cinematic shading, volumetric rays, 3D rendering or photorealism. This is a clean comic redraw, not a photo filter or a textured painting.
entries.review: 保留递饼动作、热石、牧羊人和羊群；人物与布料以连续色块表达，暖色食物与冷色环境分明。

entries.title: 雷雨后的玻璃
entries.eventDescription: 昨夜的雷击把一小片砂土熔成了树根状的玻璃。{actor}在裂开的玻璃管旁发现一件被雨水冲出的旧配件，金属骨架还很完整。
entries.scene: Branching fulgurite glass formed by lightning in pale sandy soil after a thunderstorm, a traveler with a small brush revealing a compact forgotten metal weapon attachment beside the glass roots. Dramatic departing violet storm clouds, fresh wet earth reflecting one shaft of sunlight, delicate electric glass shapes. No text.

entries.title: 无人值守的星盘
entries.eventDescription: 山脊上只剩一座生锈的观星架。{actor}转动卡住的黄铜圆环，天际与刻度忽然严丝合缝。漫长的旅程第一次在心里连成了一条清楚的弧线。
entries.scene: A lone ancient brass armillary sphere on a bare mountain observatory terrace beneath a vast star-filled indigo sky, an inquisitive cloaked traveler aligning the rings, one bright constellation mirrored by the instrument. Awe and intellectual discovery, silver stars and restrained golden brass glints, panoramic night composition. No readable symbols or text.

entries.title: 赶路的纸鸢
entries.eventDescription: 一只断线纸鸢拖着长尾落到路上。纸面画满了圆脸的小人，最末尾还留着一个空位。{actor}添上小队歪歪扭扭的合影，再把纸鸢交给迎面追来的孩子。
entries.scene: A bright handmade kite with a long patchwork ribbon tail caught beside a country path, travelers crouching to draw tiny simple stick figures on it as a laughing child runs toward them. Cheerful breezy spring composition, green hills, yellow and red kite paper dominating the foreground. No written words, no readable text.

entries.title: 两头都收费的桥
entries.eventDescription: 两位磨坊主守在小桥两端，都说自己修过桥，都收一次过路费。{actor}蹲下看了看：桥板确实是新的，支撑桥板的木销却快磨断了。两个人还在为谁的收钱碗更靠近中线争吵。
entries.scene: Two stubborn millers arguing from opposite ends of a tiny crooked wooden bridge over a narrow creek, each holding a toll bowl, a traveler kneeling to inspect a visibly worn support peg under fresh bridge planks. Wry negotiation scene, small watermill in the distance, split warm and cool sides of the bridge. No signs or text.

entries.title: 悬在树梢的邮袋
entries.eventDescription: 索道断了，一名信使吊在谷边的树杈上，邮袋比他本人还稳。{actor}能从陡坡直接攀过去，也能花时间沿山羊留下的小径绕到树后。信使只求你们别先扔掉那袋信。
entries.scene: A frightened courier dangling safely but precariously from a branch above a narrow rocky ravine after a ropeway snapped, an oversized leather mailbag wedged securely in the fork, rescuing travelers below considering a steep direct climb and a distant goat path. Tense non-gory rescue, green mountain forest, clear triangular composition. No readable letters or text.

entries.title: 无名者的木牌
entries.eventDescription: 风把孤坟前的木牌吹倒了，字迹已经磨平。一个旧匣子从土里露出角，里面有银币和一片卷起的红布。{actor}看不出墓主是谁，也不知道这份钱原本留给谁。
entries.scene: A solitary old roadside grave under a wind-bent tree, fallen blank wooden memorial marker, a half-exposed small iron box containing a few silver coins and a faded red cloth strip. One contemplative traveler kneels in the grass while companions wait at a respectful distance. Reflective muted earth tones and a single red accent, no skeletons, no readable writing.

entries.title: 三枚影子的机关
entries.eventDescription: 废塔下的石匣有太阳、月亮、火焰三枚圆钮。匣盖的刻画画着一个人：先迎晨光出门，日落后举灯，最后在月下安睡。三枚钮都能按，锁边也留着一道可撬开的缝。
entries.scene: A weathered stone puzzle chest below a ruined watchtower, three large tactile bronze buttons bearing simple sun, moon, and flame emblems, a carved pictorial frieze showing dawn travel, lamplight, and sleeping under the moon. A thoughtful traveler studies the mechanisms, strong golden side light, archaeological close-up with absolutely no written text.

entries.title: 山不喜欢掌声
entries.eventDescription: 前面的客商拍了两下手，想听山谷回声，雪檐却先回了一声闷响。{actor}看见积雪上裂开细线；脚边有一道低矮石坎，远处则是更安全的背风坡。
entries.scene: A snowy mountain pass moments before a small avalanche, a merchant with hands frozen mid-clap, a hairline crack spreading across an overhanging snow cornice, travelers pointing toward a low rock shelter and a distant safe ridge. Suspenseful wide landscape in icy blue with red scarves, airborne powder beginning to fall, no injury or text.

entries.review: 开裂雪檐、拍掌客商、指向避难处的旅人和山坡仍可辨。

entries.title: 一锅汤的赎金
entries.eventDescription: 几只森林哥布林拦住了一辆炊事车，把厨师的大汤勺高高举起。他们大声索要赎金，却又怕锅里的汤煮糊。厨师瞪着他们，小声告诉{actor}：钱能谈，汤勺不能送。
entries.scene: Three small green forest goblins surrounding a traveling cook's wooden wagon, one triumphantly brandishing an absurdly large soup ladle, another nervously stirring a bubbling cauldron, an indignant apron-wearing cook and negotiating travelers. Comic standoff in a woodland clearing, orange soup steam and moss greens, no combat gore, no text.

entries.title: 老兵只教摔倒
entries.eventDescription: 退伍老兵在路边铺了厚草垫，学徒却一个比一个摔得响。他不肯演示漂亮招式，只说：人总会被击倒，先学会怎么落地。{actor}的架势让他忍不住笑出了声。
entries.scene: A grizzled veteran with a wooden training staff teaching travelers how to fall safely onto thick straw mats beside a country road, one armored apprentice landing awkwardly while others laugh kindly. Lively physical training composition, weathered armor, hay gold and dusty blue, friendly instructor, no injury or text.

entries.title: 洪水里的窑火
entries.eventDescription: 山洪退去后，陶工围着半塌的窑棚发愁。最后一炉货正降温，坏掉的风闸却关不住。{actor}看出可以用碎瓦临时封住通风口，也可以帮他们先把干燥燃料搬走。
entries.scene: A half-flooded rural pottery kiln after the water has receded, worried potters around glowing orange furnace bricks, a skilled traveler fitting broken roof tiles into a damaged air vent, stacks of pots and damp bundled fuel nearby. Industrious rescue scene, blue puddles contrasting with warm kiln embers, no text.

entries.title: 路边的第二张担架
entries.eventDescription: 一位巡诊医师的驮兽受了惊，两名病人被留在路边。药箱足够，能抬担架的手却不够。医师已经把小队每个人的伤口看了一遍，开口求助前先说了句：你们也走得够远了。
entries.scene: A traveling field physician beside two improvised covered stretchers on a quiet roadside, frightened pack mule in the background, open orderly medical chest, weary adventurers discussing how to help carry the patients. Compassionate non-graphic medical scene, clean linen, muted red medicine bag and afternoon olive landscape. No blood or readable text.

entries.title: 篝火旁的空座
entries.eventDescription: 过路人的篝火旁留着一个空树墩。有人问{actor}愿不愿意坐下，有人已把杯子递过来。说起最狼狈的旅途，每个人都在笑；{actor}却发现，承认自己也曾害怕，比吹嘘战绩更难。
entries.scene: A welcoming circle of weathered travelers around a small night campfire, an empty tree-stump seat and a steaming cup offered toward the foreground protagonist, companions smiling with quiet understanding. Intimate emotional scene, warm orange firelight against deep blue forest night, faces visible and varied, no text.

entries.title: 落星与羊
entries.eventDescription: 一块昨夜落下的蓝色石头把草地烤成圆环，牧人的羊却执意要舔它。石头外壳已经冷了，裂缝里仍透着光。{actor}觉得它的脉动似乎能与武器上的符文呼应。
entries.scene: A small luminous blue meteorite in a circular scorched patch of meadow, a stubborn curious sheep trying to lick it while a shepherd gently holds its collar, an arcane-minded traveler inspecting glowing cracks with a tool. Whimsical magical discovery, vivid cyan stone against golden grass, twilight purple horizon, no text.

entries.title: 未开张的雪地集市
entries.eventDescription: 两个流动摊贩在雪里僵持着：卖食物的没有火，卖燃料的没带锅，谁也不肯先欠对方人情。{actor}听见两人的肚子同时响了一声。旁边的避风石圈足够容下三堆行李。
entries.scene: Two stubborn traveling merchants with snow-covered stalls facing each other in a sheltered mountain hollow, one with food and an empty cooking pot, the other with bundled firewood, adventurers between them suggesting a shared fire. Lighthearted winter survival scene, frosty blue snow, colorful blankets, a promising small amber spark, no written signs or text.

entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw Image 1 completely in the clean flat-color fantasy comic style of Image 2. Image 1 = event content and composition target. Image 2 = ONLY the approved style reference, not its character identity, clothes or tavern.
Preserve the original landscape 3:2 composition and output at 1536 x 1024. Keep the event's important characters, relationships, props and place, with the narrative moment described below. Remove the original painterly rendering, do not merely apply a filter.
STYLE: fine dark organic hand-inked contours, sparse purposeful interior strokes, expressive simplified faces, believable stylized anatomy. Large clean uninterrupted opaque flat colors. One base color and one or two crisp cel-shadow shapes per material. Match the approved reference's smooth skin, cloth and leather. Depict age and wear with only a few contour nicks and structure lines, not speckling. Simplify foliage, stone and wood into large shapes rather than hundreds of marks. Maintain a strong, immediately readable storytelling silhouette.
COLOR: adapt distinct clear cool/warm colors to the scene; cool teal/blue/green opposed to warm brick-red/ochre, selective gold and ivory highlights, blue or muted purple shadows. Do not give every character the reference costume or put castles into scenes that do not require them. Faces and key props stay legible, including night and fog scenes. Light sources and magic are simple colored shapes, no bloom or volumetric glow.
NO pervasive distressed texture, grunge, paper/parchment grain, dirty wash, dense crosshatching, muddy brown filter, photo materials, realistic painterly blending, glossy 3D, thick heavy outlines, UI, captions, text, borders, logos or watermark. One full-bleed illustration.
EVENT: A small party of four adult medieval travelers and a resting dog around a modest campfire at the open gate of an ivy-covered ruined sanctuary, carved stone guardians flank the gateway, distant valley with river, stone bridge and waterfall. Quiet adventurous camaraderie; retain the composition and general-purpose story mood.
CONTENT CONSTRAINTS: Preserve four adult travelers and dog around the small campfire, open ruined stone gate, its two carved guardians and landscape through the arch. General-purpose exploratory rest scene. Clean cool foliage, slate/lavender masonry, rust and teal clothes; brighten people against the ruin without flattening the evening mood.
entries.review: 四名旅人和犬、篝火、废墟门洞及两侧雕像保留，通用探索氛围一致。
